position_overview:
We're looking for a dynamic and mission-driven Content Creator & Talent to join our HMG streaming brands. This role is designed for someone who lives at the intersection of faith, culture, and creativity - someone who can make compelling faith foreword, produce culturally relevant podcast content, and create engaging social media that resonates with Gen Z and young adult audiences.

 Essential Functions 

 Content Creation: 

 Collaborate with the creative team to brainstorm and execute fresh, faith-forward content ideas. 

Create short-form video, audio, and written content for platforms such as, but not limited to, TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

 Engage with listeners and followers to build authentic community and drive brand engagement. 

Stay informed on trends in music, youth culture, and faith to ensure content remains timely and impactful.

Create Podcasts that connects and engages people to love Christ serve others and spread hope

Assist the Director of Audio streaming shoulder the responsibilities for programming our online only stations, particularly helping with urban programming - Gospel 24/7 & NGEN. 

Ability to voice track on occasion

 Demonstrated Faith: 

Committed to a personal relationship with Jesus Christ

Grounded spiritually and biblically literate

Comfortable praying for co-workers in team meetings, leading spoken prayer, and participating in ministry prayer meetings and Bible studies

Live Christian principles defined by the ministry’s Statement of Faith & Biblical Beliefs

Participate in on-air fundraisers and prays for donors as needed

Passion for leveraging the HMG’s media platforms for evangelism and discipleship

Exhibit a strong moral character

Active member of a Bible believing local church
qualifications:
Education: 

Bachelor’s Degree preferred, but not required

 Experience: 

Minimum of 2 years of experience in content creation: video, audio, and written content for a variety of platforms

Minimum of 2 years of experience in media

Experience in podcasting, radio, or digital audio hosting

Video editing or graphic design experience preferred

Existing connections in the Christian music or creative community preferred

Experience with youth ministry, urban outreach, or digital discipleship preferred

 Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: 

Excellent storytelling, interviewing, and audio production skills

An understanding of Christian hip-hop, pop, and Gen Z culture

Proficiency in social media content creation on platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

Familiarity with audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Pro Tools, or similar

Familiarity with video editing tools like Adobe Premier and others

Collaborative spirit, strong work ethic and self-starter mindset

Heart for Christian ministry

Strong moral character

Has a personal relationship with Jesus Christ. Spiritually grounded and working knowledge of scripture

Must be an active member of a Bible believing local church

 Supervisory Responsibilities: 

None

 Working Conditions and Environment 

 Travel: 

None

 Nights/Weekends/Holidays: 

As needed
